tasks.label: Prepare Workshop upload and launch Sephiria
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $gameDir = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PWD '..\..')); dotnet build -c Release "-p:GameDir=$gameDir"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $modDir = $PWD.Path; $metadataFile = Join-Path $modDir 'metadata.json'; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $metadataFile -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Required upload file not found: $metadataFile" }; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $modDir 'thumbnail.png') -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Required upload thumbnail.png was not found.' }; $metadata = Get-Content -LiteralPath $metadataFile -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; if (-not $metadata.mod.modules -or $metadata.mod.modules.Count -eq 0) { throw 'metadata.json does not declare any modules.' }; foreach ($module in $metadata.mod.modules) { $modulePath = Join-Path $modDir ($module.path.Replace('/', [System.IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar)); if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $modulePath)) { throw "Module path not found: $($module.path)" }; $moduleItem = Get-Item -LiteralPath $modulePath; if ($moduleItem.PSIsContainer -and -not (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $modulePath -File -Recurse | Select-Object -First 1)) { throw "Module directory is empty: $($module.path)" } }; $gameExe = [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $PWD '..\..\Sephiria.exe')); if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $gameExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Sephiria.exe was not found: $gameExe" }; Write-Host 'Workshop files are ready. Upload the mod from the in-game Steam Workshop panel.'; Start-Process -FilePath $gameExe -WorkingDirectory (Split-Path $gameExe)
